distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 90982: distance 170.94 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.046), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 170.94 +/- 7.863 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1673 +/- 0.1535 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14), 40.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 28.774 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 90982: radius 28.774 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 440.857 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.069) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 20,018,072 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
